passages.text: Then King David said to the whole assembly, “My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great because this palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to the whole assembly.
He said, "God has chosen my son Solomon.
Solomon is young.
Solomon lacks experience.
The work ahead is very great.
This palace is not for a man.
This palace is for the LORD God."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ לְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה בְנִ֥י אֶחָ֛ד בָּֽחַר־ בּ֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים נַ֣עַר וָרָ֑ךְ וְהַמְּלָאכָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְאָדָם֙ הַבִּירָ֔ה כִּ֖י לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: Now with all my ability I have made provision for the house of my God—gold for the gold articles, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron, and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and slabs of marble—all in abundance.
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to the people.
He said he prepared for the house of his God.
He used all his strength and ability.
He set aside gold for things made of gold.
He set aside silver for things made of silver.
He set aside bronze for things made of bronze.
He set aside iron for things made of iron.
He set aside wood for things made of wood.
He provided onyx stones for settings.
He provided turquoise stones.
He provided stones of many colors.
He provided all kinds of precious stones.
He provided marble slabs in great quantity.
He gave all these things in abundance for the house of God.
passages.original: וּֽכְכָל־ כֹּחִ֞י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־ אֱלֹהַ֗י הַזָּהָ֣ב׀ לַ֠זָּהָב וְהַכֶּ֨סֶף לַכֶּ֜סֶף וְהַנְּחֹ֣שֶׁת לַנְּחֹ֗שֶׁת הַבַּרְזֶל֙ לַבַּרְזֶ֔ל וְהָעֵצִ֖ים לָעֵצִ֑ים אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֨הַם וּמִלּוּאִ֜ים אַבְנֵי־ פ֣וּךְ וְרִקְמָ֗ה וְכֹ֨ל אֶ֧בֶן יְקָרָ֛ה וְאַבְנֵי־ שַׁ֖יִשׁ לָרֹֽב׃

passages.text: Moreover, because of my delight in the house of my God, I now give for it my personal treasures of gold and silver, over and above all that I have provided for this holy temple: three thousand talents of gold (the gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the buildings, for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now who will volunteer to consecrate himself to the LORD today?”
passages.sermon:
King David spoke to the assembly.
He delighted in the house of his God.
He had personal treasures of gold and silver.
He gave these treasures for the house of his God.
He gave more than all he had already provided for the holy temple.
He gave three thousand talents of gold from Ophir.
He gave seven thousand talents of refined silver.
The silver was for overlaying the walls of the buildings.
The gold was for gold work.
The silver was for silver work.
He gave for all the work to be done by the craftsmen.
He asked, “Who will volunteer today to consecrate himself to the LORD?”
passages.original: וְע֗וֹד בִּרְצוֹתִי֙ בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהַ֔י יֶשׁ־ לִ֥י סְגֻלָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב וָכָ֑סֶף נָתַ֤תִּי לְבֵית־ אֱלֹהַי֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה מִכָּל־ הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לְבֵ֥ית הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים כִּכְּרֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מִזְּהַ֣ב אוֹפִ֑יר וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֲלָפִ֤ים כִּכַּר־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ מְזֻקָּ֔ק לָט֖וּחַ קִיר֥וֹת הַבָּתִּֽים׃ לַזָּהָ֤ב לַזָּהָב֙ וְלַכֶּ֣סֶף לַכֶּ֔סֶף וּלְכָל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּיַ֣ד חָרָשִׁ֑ים וּמִ֣י מִתְנַדֵּ֔ב לְמַלֹּ֥אות יָד֛וֹ הַיּ֖וֹם לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then the leaders of the households, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of the households gave willingly.
The officers of the tribes of Israel gave willingly.
The commanders of thousands gave willingly.
The commanders of hundreds gave willingly.
The officials in charge of the king’s work gave willingly.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְנַדְּבוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָאָב֜וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י׀ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְשָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְהַמֵּא֔וֹת וּלְשָׂרֵ֖י מְלֶ֥אכֶת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: Toward the service of God’s house they gave 5,000 talents and 10,000 darics of gold, 10,000 talents of silver, 18,000 talents of bronze, and 100,000 talents of iron.
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Israel gave gifts for the work of God’s house.
They gave 5,000 talents of gold.
They gave 10,000 darics of gold.
They gave 10,000 talents of silver.
They gave 18,000 talents of bronze.
They gave 100,000 talents of iron.
passages.original: וַֽיִּתְּנ֞וּ לַעֲבוֹדַ֣ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֣ים חֲמֵֽשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִים֮ וַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֣ים רִבּוֹ֒ וְכֶ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּנְחֹ֕שֶׁת רִבּ֛וֹ וּשְׁמוֹנַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים כִּכָּרִ֑ים וּבַרְזֶ֖ל מֵֽאָה־ אֶ֥לֶף כִּכָּרִֽים׃

passages.text: Whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of the LORD, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
passages.sermon: Anyone who had precious stones gave them.\r\nThey gave the stones to the treasury of the house of the LORD.\r\nJehiel the Gershonite took care of the treasury.
passages.original: וְהַנִּמְצָ֤א אִתּוֹ֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ לְאוֹצַ֣ר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֑ה עַ֥ל יַד־ יְחִיאֵ֖ל הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃

passages.text: And the people rejoiced at the willing response of their leaders, for they had given to the LORD freely and wholeheartedly. And King David also rejoiced greatly.
passages.sermon:
The people gave gifts to the LORD.
They gave freely.
They gave with whole hearts.
The people rejoiced because they gave willingly.
King David was their leader.
King David also rejoiced greatly.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֤וּ הָעָם֙ עַל־ הִֽתְנַדְּבָ֔ם כִּ֚י בְּלֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם הִֽתְנַדְּב֖וּ לַיהוָ֑ה וְגַם֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂמַ֖ח שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David stood before all the people.
David blessed the LORD.
David spoke to the whole assembly.
David said, “You are blessed, LORD.
You are the God of our father Israel.
You are blessed forever.
You are blessed from everlasting to everlasting.”
passages.original: וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד בָּר֨וּךְ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָבִ֔ינוּ מֵעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the splendor and the majesty, for everything in heaven and on earth belongs to You. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom, and You are exalted as head over all.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is great.
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD is glorious.
The LORD is splendid.
The LORD is majestic.
Everything in heaven belongs to the LORD.
Everything on earth belongs to the LORD.
The LORD owns the kingdom.
The LORD is above all.
The LORD is exalted as head over everything.
passages.original: לְךָ֣ יְ֠הוָה הַגְּדֻלָּ֨ה וְהַגְּבוּרָ֤ה וְהַתִּפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ וְהַנֵּ֣צַח וְהַה֔וֹד כִּי־ כֹ֖ל בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ לְךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַמַּמְלָכָ֔ה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂ֖א לְכֹ֥ל׀ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

passages.text: Both riches and honor come from You, and You are the ruler over all. In Your hands are power and might to exalt and give strength to all.
passages.sermon:
God gives riches.
God gives honor.
God rules over everything.
God holds power in His hand.
God holds might in His hand.
God can make anyone great.
God can give strength to everyone.
passages.original: וְהָעֹ֤שֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד֙ מִלְּפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַתָּה֙ מוֹשֵׁ֣ל בַּכֹּ֔ל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ כֹּ֣חַ וּגְבוּרָ֑ה וּבְיָ֣דְךָ֔ לְגַדֵּ֥ל וּלְחַזֵּ֖ק לַכֹּֽל׃

passages.text: Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
passages.sermon: God is our God.\r\nWe give thanks to You, God.\r\nWe praise Your glorious name.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ מוֹדִ֥ים אֲנַ֖חְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וּֽמְהַֽלְלִ֖ים לְשֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאַרְתֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
passages.sermon:
God gives everything.
God is the source of all things.
We are His people.
We do not have power by ourselves to give generously.
We can only give because God gives to us first.
Everything we give comes from God’s own hand.
We return to God what He has already given us.
passages.original: וְכִ֨י מִ֤י אֲנִי֙ וּמִ֣י עַמִּ֔י כִּֽי־ נַעְצֹ֣ר כֹּ֔חַ לְהִתְנַדֵּ֖ב כָּזֹ֑את כִּֽי־ מִמְּךָ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל וּמִיָּדְךָ֖ נָתַ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: For we are foreigners and strangers in Your presence, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.
passages.sermon:
We are foreigners before You, God.
We are strangers in Your presence.
Our forefathers were also foreigners and strangers before You.
Our days on earth are like a shadow.
We have no hope on our own.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֨ים אֲנַ֧חְנוּ לְפָנֶ֛יךָ וְתוֹשָׁבִ֖ים כְּכָל־ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ כַּצֵּ֧ל׀ יָמֵ֛ינוּ עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין מִקְוֶֽה׃

passages.text: O LORD our God, from Your hand comes all this abundance that we have provided to build You a house for Your holy Name, and all of it belongs to You.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are our God.
We have gathered much wealth and resources.
We prepared all these things to build a house for Your holy Name.
All this abundance comes from Your hand.
Everything belongs to You.
passages.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כֹ֣ל הֶהָמ֤וֹן הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲכִינֹ֔נוּ לִבְנֽוֹת־ לְךָ֥ בַ֖יִת לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ מִיָּדְךָ֥ הִיא וּלְךָ֥ הַכֹּֽל׃

passages.text: I know, my God, that You test the heart and delight in uprightness. All these things I have given willingly and with an upright heart, and now I have seen Your people who are present here giving joyfully and willingly to You.
passages.sermon:
God, You are my God.
You test the heart.
You delight in uprightness.
I have given all these things willingly.
I gave them with an upright heart.
Now I see Your people here.
They give to You joyfully.
They give to You willingly.
passages.original: וְיָדַ֣עְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן לֵבָ֔ב וּמֵישָׁרִ֖ים תִּרְצֶ֑ה אֲנִ֗י בְּיֹ֤שֶׁר לְבָבִי֙ הִתְנַדַּ֣בְתִּי כָל־ אֵ֔לֶּה וְעַתָּ֗ה עַמְּךָ֙ הַנִּמְצְאוּ־ פֹ֔ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְשִׂמְחָ֖ה לְהִֽתְנַדֶּב־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: O LORD, God of our fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep this desire forever in the intentions of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts toward You.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of our fathers.
Our fathers are Abraham, Isaac, and Israel.
LORD, keep this desire in the hearts of Your people forever.
Let Your people always want to serve You.
Guide their hearts to turn toward You.
passages.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵי אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שֳׁמְרָה־ זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And give my son Solomon a whole heart to keep and carry out all Your commandments, decrees, and statutes, and to build Your palace for which I have made provision.”
passages.sermon:
David spoke to God.
David was the king of Israel.
David prayed for his son Solomon.
David asked God to give Solomon a whole heart.
David wanted Solomon to obey all of God’s commandments.
David wanted Solomon to keep God’s decrees.
David wanted Solomon to follow God’s statutes.
David wanted Solomon to do everything God commanded.
David wanted Solomon to build the palace.
David had prepared for the palace to be built.
passages.original: וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֗י תֵּ֚ן לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם לִשְׁמוֹר֙ מִצְוֺתֶ֔יךָ עֵדְוֺתֶ֖יךָ וְחֻקֶּ֑יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֣וֹת הַכֹּ֔ל וְלִבְנ֖וֹת הַבִּירָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֲכִינֽוֹתִי׃פ

passages.text: Then David said to the whole assembly, “Blessed be the LORD your God.” So the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their fathers. They bowed down and paid homage to the LORD and to the king.
passages.sermon:
David spoke to the whole assembly.
David said, “Bless the LORD your God.”
The whole assembly blessed the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
The people bowed down.
They paid homage to the LORD.
They also paid homage to the king.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל־ הַקָּהָ֔ל בָּֽרְכוּ־ נָ֖א אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וַיְבָרֲכ֣וּ כָֽל־ הַקָּהָ֗ל לַיהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹֽתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְּד֧וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לַיהוָ֖ה וְלַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: The next day they offered sacrifices and presented burnt offerings to the LORD: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, along with their drink offerings, and other sacrifices in abundance for all Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel gathered together.
They offered sacrifices to the LORD.
They presented burnt offerings to the LORD.
This happened the day after the assembly.
They sacrificed one thousand bulls.
They sacrificed one thousand rams.
They sacrificed one thousand lambs.
They brought drink offerings with these animals.
They gave many other sacrifices.
They did this for all Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה׀ זְ֠בָחִים וַיַּעֲל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְֽמָחֳרַת֮ הַיּ֣וֹם הַהוּא֒ פָּרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף אֵילִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף כְּבָשִׂ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֑ם וּזְבָחִ֥ים לָרֹ֖ב לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: That day they ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD. Then, for a second time, they designated David’s son Solomon as king, anointing him before the LORD as ruler, and Zadok as the priest.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel gathered before the LORD.
They ate and drank that day.
They felt great joy.
They celebrated in the presence of the LORD.
They made Solomon king again.
Solomon was the son of David.
They anointed Solomon as ruler before the LORD.
They also anointed Zadok as priest.
passages.original: וַיֹּאכְל֨וּ וַיִּשְׁתּ֜וּ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַיַּמְלִ֤יכוּ שֵׁנִית֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בֶן־ דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ לַיהוָ֛ה לְנָגִ֥יד וּלְצָד֖וֹק לְכֹהֵֽן׃

passages.text: So Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king in place of his father David. He prospered, and all Israel obeyed him.
passages.sermon:
Solomon became king after his father David.
Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD.
Solomon ruled over Israel.
Solomon succeeded in his reign.
All Israel obeyed Solomon.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב שְׁ֠לֹמֹה עַל־ כִּסֵּ֨א יְהוָ֧ה׀ לְמֶ֛לֶךְ תַּֽחַת־ דָּוִ֥יד אָבִ֖יו וַיַּצְלַ֑ח וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: All the officials and mighty men, as well as all of King David’s sons, pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled Israel after his father David.
All the officials gave their support to King Solomon.
All the mighty men gave their support to King Solomon.
All the sons of King David gave their support to King Solomon.
They all pledged their allegiance to King Solomon.
passages.original: וְכָל־ הַשָּׂרִים֙ וְהַגִּבֹּרִ֔ים וְגַ֕ם כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑יד נָ֣תְנוּ יָ֔ד תַּ֖חַת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

passages.text: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal majesty such as had not been bestowed on any king in Israel before him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD exalted Solomon.
The LORD made Solomon great.
All Israel saw this.
The LORD gave Solomon royal majesty.
No king in Israel before Solomon had such majesty.
passages.original: וַיְגַדֵּ֨ל יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְמַ֔עְלָה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָיו֙ ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֔וּת אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־ הָיָ֧ה עַל־ כָּל־ מֶ֛לֶךְ לְפָנָ֖יו עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

passages.text: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
passages.sermon: David was the son of Jesse.\r\nDavid was king.\r\nDavid ruled over all Israel.
passages.original: וְדָוִיד֙ בֶּן־ יִשָׁ֔י מָלַ֖ךְ עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The length of David’s reign over Israel was forty years—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
David was king over all Israel.
He ruled for forty years.
He ruled in Hebron for seven years.
He ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
passages.original: וְהַיָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלַךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּחֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם מָלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְשָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃

passages.text: He died at a ripe old age, full of years, riches, and honor, and his son Solomon reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
David was king over all Israel.
David was the son of Jesse.
David died at a good old age.
David was full of years.
David had riches.
David had honor.
Solomon was David’s son.
Solomon became king after David.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙מָת֙ בְּשֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֔ה שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִ֖ים עֹ֣שֶׁר וְכָב֑וֹד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: Now the acts of King David, from first to last, are indeed written in the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer, together with all the details of his reign, his might, and the circumstances that came upon him and Israel and all the kingdoms of the lands.
passages.sermon:
King David ruled Israel.
Writers recorded all his deeds.
They wrote about his early acts and his later acts.
Samuel the Seer wrote about David.
Nathan the Prophet wrote about David.
Gad the Seer wrote about David.
These records include every part of David’s reign.
They tell about his power.
They describe the events that happened to him.
They tell what happened to Israel.
They include what happened to all the kingdoms around Israel.
passages.original: וְדִבְרֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְהָאֲחרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֣ל הָרֹאֶ֔ה וְעַל־ דִּבְרֵי֙ נָתָ֣ן הַנָּבִ֔יא וְעַל־ דִּבְרֵ֖י גָּ֥ד הַחֹזֶֽה׃ עִ֥ם כָּל־ מַלְכוּת֖וֹ וּגְבוּרָת֑וֹ וְהָעִתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ עָלָיו֙ וְעַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאֲרָצֽוֹת׃פ
